project_type: Next.js 16 app with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, App Router architecture
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify the change compiles successfully
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Riot API key is expired/invalid (returns 401).
contribution_requirements: TypeScript must pass, ESLint must pass, build must succeed. No test suite configured.
key_patterns: API route in app/api/riot/route.ts uses RiotApiError class from lib/riot-api.ts. Error handling uses switch on status codes in riotFetch. The route returns ApiErrorResponse type objects on errors.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js app router pages and API routes; lib/ - shared utilities, types, API helpers; public/ - static assets
